scope: Tenth batch: 5 geometric MTF, 5 diffraction MTF and 5 square-wave transfer operands

support_boundaries.sampling: Grid=1 only; Samp 1..5 maps to Workbench pupil axis sizes 32..512, with FFT double-side zero padding; native MFE grid mapping not captured. Grid=0 rejected.
support_boundaries.frequency: cycles/mm for focal, cycles/mrad for afocal; other Zemax frequency display units not adapted.
support_boundaries.polychromatic: Positive spectral weights; each wavelength complex OTF interpolated once at the target physical frequency before spectral combination. No equal-weight fallback. Positive Wave ignores spectral weight.
support_boundaries.data_type: MTFA/S/T: 0 magnitude, 1 real, 2 imaginary, 3 phase in degrees. N/X modulation only. A/S/T/N/X are mean, sagittal, tangential, min, max of directional responses.
support_boundaries.field: GMT requires positive field index. FFT/square Field=0 uses axial pupil with OPD removed; apertures and apodization retained.
support_boundaries.square_wave: Shared Coltman odd harmonics, at most 999th harmonic and limited to OTF grid range; finite harmonic and sampling errors remain.
support_boundaries.migration: Raw Data1 Field checked as integer and in range; stale typed Field cannot hide invalid raw references.
support_boundaries.remaining_mtf: MECA and MTHA/MTHS/MTHT/MTHN/MTHX remain compatibility-only; Huygens requires seven-parameter/multiconfiguration transport.

external_reference.integrity: Eight selected baseline assets byte-equal committed HEAD; not entire baseline audit.
external_reference.recalculation: Existing Workbench fixed-fixture regressions passed with captured file/settings/version.
external_reference.numerical_comparison: Existing Huygens MTF, MTF-vs-field and through-focus captured-setting comparisons passed, alongside prior fixed regressions; this is not equivalence evidence for new FFT/geometric MFE operands.
external_reference.new_operands: Independent discrete Fourier, circular pupil, complex-grid tests and integration/optimization; no new native MFE slots, sampling or numerical captures.

historical_reference: Frozen assets untouched; no new Optiland comparisons
